verdict.rationale: A state employment agency running online employer filing systems (EAMS, eServices) could plausibly publish versioned APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing web portals, paper and PDF forms, and videos. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and the transactional host redirects all keyless requests to a SecureAccess Washington login. There is no evidence of versioned APIs or a deprecation policy.
